sample_unit: patients (retrospective multicenter cohort; plus 151 prospective patients)

links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy and sensitivity with versus without PancDS assistance, including case-level deterioration
links.effect: PancDS significantly improved accuracy and sensitivity, with the largest gains in intermediate and junior radiologists (P < 0.001) and minimal case-level deterioration (1.5-3.9%).
links.quote: In a reader study, PancDS significantly improves diagnostic accuracy and sensitivity, with the largest gains in intermediate and junior radiologists (P < 0.001) and minimal case-level deterioration (1.5-3.9%), functioning as a diagnostic equalizer.

screen.reason: The study conducts a prospective multicenter evaluation and a reader study assessing the impact of AI assistance on radiologist diagnostic performance across experience levels.
